evals.prompt: Open my newest Claude chat, save the full original in Main Vault, then digest any useful engineering lessons. It may already have an older summary.
evals.expected_output: Deduplicates by provider ID, preserves or creates a verified source archive, reuses the existing digest when appropriate, fact-checks engineering claims, and updates the ledger.

evals.prompt: Go through this Gemini conversation about a relationship trigger and file it properly, but keep private details out of public notes.
evals.expected_output: Uses a private source-archive path, preserves the source, separates user-attested experience from factual claims, routes only a suitable emotional/journal delta, and keeps the ledger minimally identifying.

evals.prompt: Sort the old AI conversation notes in my vault and restore all missing originals.
evals.expected_output: Runs a read-only legacy audit, distinguishes transcript-like notes from digests, backfills only from available provider sources or exports, never fabricates originals, and produces a clear remaining queue.
